test_title: PYST 96: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 10 Jan, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following was one of the main objectives of the Seventh Five-Year Plan?

options.text: Increase in production of Food Grains

solution:
The correct answer is **Increase in production of Food Grains**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Seventh Five-Year Plan

__
 
• Its duration was from 1985 to 1990, under the leadership of Rajiv Gandhi. 
 
• The objectives of this plan include the establishment of a self-sufficient economy, opportunities for productive employment, and up-gradation of technology.
 
• The Plan aimed at accelerating food grain production, increasing employment opportunities & raising productivity with a focus on ‘food, work & productivity.
 
• For the first time, the private sector got priority over the public sector. 
 
• Its growth target was 5.0% but it achieved 6.01%.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The first five-year plan in India was launched in 1951 and since then, India has witnessed twelve Five Year Plans.
 
• The present government had however discontinued the Five-year plan system and a new mechanism was put into place.
 
• The decades-old Five-Year Plans was replaced by a three-year action plan, which will be part of a seven-year strategy paper and a 15-year vision document.
 
• The Niti Aayog has replaced the Planning Commission in the Modi Cabinet and launched three-year action plans from April 1, 2017, onwards.
